assessment_definitions.matches: The relevant operation family or observable responsibility exists; no binary-identical or complete runtime parity is asserted.
assessment_definitions.differs: A concrete arithmetic, supported-domain, parameter, representation or workflow difference; not automatically a defect.
assessment_definitions.missing: An evidenced capability is absent from the inspected Quader API/owners; related function records may describe the same feature.
assessment_definitions.support: Container, topology, numerical, registration, metadata, publication or runtime support; not an independent missing user feature.
assessment_definitions.unresolved: The body/export or opaque dispatch does not establish the required exact behavior; no invented capability fills the gap.

evidence_limits: Machine-generated pseudocode is not Valve original C++ source.
Every successfully exported assigned body was read in full by its shard reviewer; the consolidated reviewer read all six ledgers and findings.
Assembly was consulted where decompiler signatures or expressions materially affected the conclusion.
No recovered routine was compiled or executed, and no controlled Hammer input/output parity test was performed.
UI/property registration proves exposed controls or metadata, not unreviewed downstream algorithms.
Selector value 3 in reviewed channel wrappers means all available channels, not a three-channel maximum.
Lightmap generation, island packing, UV relaxation, manual pin editing, hotspot matching, UV-derived hard edges and component-lock execution semantics are not established by labels/preferences alone.
Quader tests were inspected as behavior evidence; current task build/test execution is recorded separately by the coordinator.

functions.role: Constructs the Texture State / Modify Texture Qt panel and wires its distinct texture operations.
evidence: Complete decompiled/180237880.c lines 1-1153 read. Lines 78-481 construct independent X/Y scale, X/Y shift and rotation controls. Lines 524 and 569 give the adjacent Fit X/Y integers ranges 1..128; lines 831-887 place them alongside the three Fit buttons. Lines 629-639 wire grid, face, view and two cylindrical variants. Lines 777-806 wire separate texture-vector flips and explicit Face UV flips. Lines 957-1007 wire Treat as one. Lines 1013-1150 conditionally build a lightmap resolution section. Assembly 0x180239397..0x180239440 confirms three Fit callbacks whose arguments the decompiler omitted. Read-only decoding of referenced .rdata strings confirms cylinder labels 'Align to Cylinder (Z = V axis)' and '(Z = U axis)', Fit labels X/Y, and Treat as one.
functions.details: Much of the existing panel already has direct Quader counterparts: scale/shift/rotation, Grid/Face/View, Fit Both/X/Y, justification, texture flips and Treat as One. Three concrete surface differences remain. Hammer exposes UV-only face flips, while Quader's similarly placed Flip Face H/V are confirmed geometry reflections: they move vertices and reverse face winding, with tests explicitly expecting changed geometry. Quader has no dedicated bounds-centered UV-only flip action in its public enum/portable dispatcher. Hammer also presents two integer controls next to Fit; Quader Fit always normalizes selected bounds to one tile and has no requested repeat extents in the UI/API/options. Finally Hammer offers two cylinder U/V assignments; Quader has cylinder projection (so cylinder support is NOT missing), but its sole API action fixes longitude to U and height to V with local-Y cylinder axis. This constructor proves those control/action distinctions, not numerical equivalence of their downstream algorithms or scale-preservation behavior. The conditional lightmap and subdivision controls are not classified as missing UV-alignment functionality.

functions.role: Choose unwrap alignment edge and orientation from the active viewport

This belongs to the absent general face-unwrap workflow; changing existing guided Peel orientation would be a behavioral change, not a proven bug.

functions.role: Camera-basis planar projection of selected corner UVs
evidence: Complete decompiled/1803111b0.c inspected. Resizes a UV output array, maps corner handles to vertices, transforms XYZ and writes two dot products with supplied view axes. functions.details: Quader AlignToView implements the same camera-plane projection capability from captured right/up axes and world positions. Quader additionally preserves persistent face settings and converts material pixel dimensions; byte-identical raw UVs across these different scale conventions are not claimed. Camera projection is not missing.

functions.role: UV unwrap mode dispatcher

The exact labels of all numeric modes are not proven by this body; this is a workflow/parameter difference, not a demonstrated incorrect Quader result.
